<function name="StartBeam" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
	<rendercontext hook="false" type="3D"></rendercontext>

	Begin drawing a multi-segment Beam.

			For more detailed information on Beams, as well as usage examples, see the <page text="Beams Render Reference">render_beams</page>.

	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="segmentCount" type="number">The number of Beam Segments that this multi-segment Beam will contain.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
